usage.limitation: Missing diagnostics are not zero cost. Only provider-returned usage is measurable.

limitations: These automated scores are provisional, not independent proof of every statement.
Source relevance and material omissions require semantic review.
Similarity flags identify possible FAQ-like behavior; they are not hidden by formatting changes.
Deterministic safety/clarification notices are reported separately from factual RAG reuse; this does not claim their wording varies.
A finite100-scenario pass cannot guarantee all future examiner questions.
